gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-yi: Redux stretches its letters wide and swoops into every curve with a visible entrance stroke. Noto Sans Yi stays compact and sans-serif, with a deep midsection and open rounds, and that is where it does its best work.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-sans-zanabazar-: Redux spaces its enlarged lowercase generously, with a stroke that thickens and thins just enough to notice. Noto Sans Zanabazar Square soars tall and stays crisp even when small.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-noto-traditional-nus: Noto Traditional Nushu reads like a broad-nibbed pen, its bowls filling the line. Redux sits above it with wide spacing and stems a touch heavier than its crossbars, so the page feels geometric on top and handwritten underneath.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-numans: Numans reads as a plain sans with chunky, tightly coiled lowercase and an s whose ends hang far from the spine. And Redux, wide and geometric above it, gives that dense text some breathing room to lean against.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-onest: Approachable is the first word that comes to mind for Onest, with short ascenders above big bowls. And its single steady line thickness keeps a long passage flowing, while Redux swells gently on its curves above.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-orienta: Redux sprawls wide, with big entrances into its curves and stroke widths that shift just enough to notice. And Orienta, a sans-serif with hollow-reed counters, works nicely at a modest size beside it.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-oxygen: Clean is the word for Oxygen, whose curves never close back on themselves. Oxygen keeps its lowercase nearly matching the capitals, so a long passage moves along in a plain sans rhythm below Redux.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-parkinsans: Parkinsans draws one stroke thickness everywhere, with wide-mouthed letters that stay crisp when shrunk. And Redux, thinning slightly at the sides of its bowls, supplies the geometric flourish this sans-serif body lacks.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-pathway-extreme: Wide, bold and a bit playful. Pathway Extreme, a sans with stubby ascenders and a big x-height, can run a little smaller, since its rounded openings stay clear.
gen-dafont-redux-gf-preahvihear: Wide-set and show-offy, with swooping curve entrances. Preahvihear, a lofty sans with a mouth like a pried oyster shell, would look lost if the heading were made small.
